name: chart-bar
title: Bar Chart
description: Three dark analytics cards showing bar charts: grouped monthly columns, horizontal browser bars and a chart with values below the baseline. Hovering shows a small tooltip.
use: A dashboard needs a few compact bar charts to compare categories or months.
avoid: All three cards hardcode their datasets and copy, so each needs data and labels edited in source.
a11y: The accessibility layer supplies chart names, but tooltip values stay pointer-only. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three bordered dark cards sit side by side with grey bar charts. The first pairs narrow columns per month, the second runs long horizontal bars with browser names at left, the third has columns rising and falling around a zero line.
behaves: Hovering a bar dims the rest and shows a small tooltip with the series and value. The negative chart tints values below zero in a lighter grey and keeps month names above each bar.
customise: Each variant hardcodes its data array, title and footer in the file; adapting it means replacing those values and the chart config.
weight: light: Three small SVG charts with six categories each; no animation loop.
demo: Visitors for January to June 2024, browsers Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge and Other.
polishWhy: Clean standard bar cards, but grey and fairly interchangeable.
